unction is not a simple polynomial.
- The residual is largest at early times (t < 2) and at low P, which points to a missing sharp early-time or low-density structure.

The best structure I found (NMSE ≈ 7e-4, k≈3) is: a + bP + cP² + d/P + e·t + f·tP + g·t² + h·t²P + i·tP² + j·t/(k+t) + l·P·t/(k+t).
